diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,7 +1,109 @@
-
-class ConnectGame:
-    def __init__(self, board: str):
-        pass
-
-    def get_winner(self) -> str:
-        pass
+class ConnectGame:
+    def __init__(self, board: str):
+        # Parse the board into a 2D grid
+        lines = board.strip().split('\n')
+        self.board = []
+        for line in lines:
+            row = line.strip().split()
+            self.board.append(row)
+        
+        self.rows = len(self.board)
+        self.cols = len(self.board[0]) if self.rows > 0 else 0
+
+    def get_winner(self) -> str:
+        # Check if player 'O' has won (top to bottom)
+        if self._is_connected('O', 0, self.rows - 1):
+            return 'O'
+        
+        # Check if player 'X' has won (left to right)
+        if self._is_connected('X', 0, self.cols - 1):
+            return 'X'
+        
+        return ''
+
+    def _is_connected(self, player, start_edge, end_edge):
+        if player == 'O':
+            # For 'O', check connection from top row to bottom row
+            # Start from all 'O' cells in the top row
+            visited = set()
+            stack = []
+            
+            # Add all 'O' cells in the top row to the stack
+            for j in range(self.cols):
+                if self.board[0][j] == player:
+                    stack.append((0, j))
+                    visited.add((0, j))
+            
+            # DFS to find path to bottom row
+            while stack:
+                row, col = stack.pop()
+                
+                # If we reached the bottom row, player 'O' wins
+                if row == self.rows - 1:
+                    return True
+                
+                # Check all 6 neighbors in hex grid
+                neighbors = self._get_neighbors(row, col)
+                for nr, nc in neighbors:
+                    if (nr, nc) not in visited and 0 <= nr < self.rows and 0 <= nc < self.cols:
+                        if self.board[nr][nc] == player:
+                            visited.add((nr, nc))
+                            stack.append((nr, nc))
+            
+            return False
+            
+        else:  # player == 'X'
+            # For 'X', check connection from left column to right column
+            # Start from all 'X' cells in the left column
+            visited = set()
+            stack = []
+            
+            # Add all 'X' cells in the left column to the stack
+            for i in range(self.rows):
+                if self.board[i][0] == player:
+                    stack.append((i, 0))
+                    visited.add((i, 0))
+            
+            # DFS to find path to right column
+            while stack:
+                row, col = stack.pop()
+                
+                # If we reached the right column, player 'X' wins
+                if col == self.cols - 1:
+                    return True
+                
+                # Check all 6 neighbors in hex grid
+                neighbors = self._get_neighbors(row, col)
+                for nr, nc in neighbors:
+                    if (nr, nc) not in visited and 0 <= nr < self.rows and 0 <= nc < self.cols:
+                        if self.board[nr][nc] == player:
+                            visited.add((nr, nc))
+                            stack.append((nr, nc))
+            
+            return False
+
+    def _get_neighbors(self, row, col):
+        # Hex grid neighbors
+        # Even rows: offset to the right
+        # Odd rows: offset to the left
+        neighbors = []
+        
+        # Top and bottom neighbors (same column)
+        neighbors.append((row - 1, col))
+        neighbors.append((row + 1, col))
+        
+        # For hexagonal grid, the left/right neighbors depend on the row
+        if row % 2 == 0:
+            # Even row
+            neighbors.append((row, col - 1))  # left
+            neighbors.append((row, col + 1))  # right
+            neighbors.append((row - 1, col - 1))  # top-left
+            neighbors.append((row - 1, col + 1))  # top-right
+        else:
+            # Odd row
+            neighbors.append((row, col - 1))  # left
+            neighbors.append((row, col + 1))  # right
+            neighbors.append((row + 1, col - 1))  # bottom-left
+            neighbors.append((row + 1, col + 1))  # bottom-right
+            
+        return neighbors
